svg.title: How a run flows: scenario, engine, outputs, consumers
svg.desc: How a run flows. A scenario TOML file (a kind, a seed and its parameters) goes into the engine, kshana 0.29.0, through api::run_toml, a typed dispatch over 75 kinds, deterministic from scenario, seed and engine version. The engine writes result.json, chart.svg, report.html and report.json, a table.csv for the kinds that define one, and on request SP3, CCSDS OMM and OEM, CZML, KML, GeoJSON, STK and SigMF exports; a suite writes study.json and study.html. Those files feed Kshana Studio in the browser, an AI assistant through the kshana-mcp server, and continuous integration.
